instructions: Upload a JSON array. This describes fields only and contains no sample prices. Use observations you are entitled to store privately.

required_fields.purity: exact source purity, or explicitly 'not stated'
required_fields.assessed_at: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp with timezone
required_fields.currency: ISO code, e.g. USD or CNY
required_fields.mean: source number, or null; do not fabricate midpoint
